_README: THE ONLY HAND-MAINTAINED HALF of the AutoCount coverage table, and the only
thing here that source cannot answer: which operations have actually been
run against the licensed AED_HOUZS book, and under which document number.
An entry is admissible ONLY with a document number or a query that can be
re-run. 'Someone said it worked' is not an entry -- four hand-written
coverage tables disagreed with each other before this file existed, and the
disagreement was found by reading them, not by anything failing.
Everything else in docs/generated/autocount-coverage.md is DERIVED from
source on every run: which operations exist, which the service implements,
and which routes actually enqueue them. Do not hand-write those anywhere.
Add an entry the day the document number exists. Never add one in advance.

create_so.evidence: scm.autocount_outbox holds two rows with status='sent' for these; re-runnable with .github/workflows/autocount-outbox-health.yml
create_so.note: The only operation ever to reach the book through the QUEUE.

so_to_do.evidence: SELECT DocNo, DebtorCode, Cancelled FROM DO WHERE DocNo IN ('HC-DO-2608-001','HC-DO-2608-002') returns both against 300-C002, Cancelled='F'; the service log for 00:55:30 carries 'FullTransfer OK' for each
so_to_do.note: DO-011260 (2026-08-12) came from qa-convert.ps1 driven directly on the host, NOT through the outbox, and was cancelled afterwards -- a real DO running number was consumed and scm.autocount_outbox has no record of it. The two HC- documents are the ERP's own numbers and landed on 2026-08-17 once the target was given a DebtorCode before the transfer; note that they were driven from a hand-patched host build, so the outbox is not the record for these either.

do_to_iv.evidence: SELECT DocNo, DebtorCode, Cancelled FROM IV WHERE DocNo = 'HC-SI-2608-001' returns 300-C002, Cancelled='F'
do_to_iv.note: First invoice this service has ever put in the book. It had been blocked behind the two delivery orders above; the same DebtorCode fix released all three.

so_to_po.evidence: host log 10:15 'so-to-po PO-009968: 2 transferred, 2 line(s) costed in phase two'; HC-PO-2608-001 is attested by the transfer that consumed it -- /po-to-gr logged 'trying purchase FullTransfer from=HC-PO-2608-001 tf=PurchaseOrder' followed by 'purchase FullTransfer OK', and FullTransfer cannot name a document the book does not hold
so_to_po.note: PO-009968 was AutoCount's own number, the D5 defect; it was cancelled with the owner's approval and re-raised as HC-PO-2608-001 by the #2369 one-document requeue. The op is so_to_po and NOT create_po -- this purchase order came from a sales order, so it took the transfer arm. create_po is still undemonstrated.

po_to_gr.evidence: POST /po-to-gr answered {"ok":true,"docNo":"HC-GR-2608-001","lines":[{"DtlKey":908162,"ItemCode":"9028-1A(LHF)"},{"DtlKey":908164,"ItemCode":"9028-2A(RHF)"}]}; the host log at 23:09:04 carries 'target creditor before transfer = [400-H004]', 'trying purchase FullTransfer from=HC-PO-2608-001 tf=PurchaseOrder' and 'purchase FullTransfer OK'
po_to_gr.note: The first purchase-side conversion this service has ever put in the book, after failing since 2026-08-12 on 'IndexOutOfRangeException: There is no row at position -1'. Driven from a HAND-PATCHED host build (builtAt 2026-08-17T15:05:51Z, mvid ad2cad05-e817-4318-b4a0-1a4b6b2d8d03) with a CreditorCode supplied by hand, NOT through the outbox -- so scm.autocount_outbox is not the record for it, and the payload half only became automatic when this PR landed. NOT re-runnable from a checkout: the log and the book are both on the office host.

gr_to_pi.note: Same host session and same hand-patched build as po_to_gr above, and blocked behind it for the same reason a GRN is blocked behind a PO. With it, all six ERP document types exist in AED_HOUZS under the ERP's own numbers.

cancel.evidence: POST /cancel {"DocType":"PO","DocNo":"PO-009968"} -> {"ok":true}, then SELECT DocNo, Cancelled FROM PO WHERE DocNo='PO-009968' -> Cancelled = T
cancel.note: DO-011260 was cancelled in the same 2026-08-12 host session that created it. PO-009968 is the second, and the first cancel driven for a real reason rather than a trial -- it carried AutoCount's own number instead of the ERP's.

notDemonstrated.create_po: FK_PO_PurchaseAgent blocked it on 2026-08-12. The cause is fixed in source (readPoHeader sends the constant AC_PURCHASE_AGENT, autocount-outbox.ts) but no purchase order has reached the book through the CREATE arm since. HC-PO-2608-001 does not count for this row: it came from a sales order and therefore took so_to_po.
notDemonstrated.edit: Exercised against the live book as the four refusal guards (a passing guard writes nothing, which is what makes it safe there). No edit has been demonstrated to CHANGE a document in the book.
